create_dataloader: create a DataLoader instance with a specified split, input_db, batch_size, and preprocess function
get_input_db: get an ImageDataset input database object for a given dataset name and data split type
start_dataloader_threads: start all worker and enqueuer threads in the DataLoader with optional queue prefilling
shutdown_dataloader: shutdown the DataLoader by stopping the coordinator, closing blobs queues, and joining all threads
register_sigint_handler: register a SIGINT signal handler on the DataLoader to gracefully shut down all loader threads
